newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia to import 53,000 tons of meat - paper.
newsitem.headline: Croatia to import 53,000 tons of meat - paper.

text.p: Croatia will this year import some 53,000 tonnes of meat, including beef, pork and lamb, ahead of the summer tourist season, a newspaper reported on Saturday.
Zagreb daily Vjesnik quoted cattle-raisers' guild Croatiastocar as saying domestic production of meat could not meet the country's annual consumption, estimated at 273,000 tonnes.
The daily did not say who would import the meat or where from.

The government has also vowed to grant some 70 million kuna ($11.5 million) loans at favourable terms for purchasing extra 7,800 tonnes of meat, required for the tourist season, which begins at Easter and peaks in the summer.
Croatiastocar said the country has all the facilities to produce all the meat it needs.

However, uncontrolled import and lack of consistent subsidies to farmers has forced Croatia to import about a half of its annual pork and beef consumption, it said. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
